This FloPlast MiniFlo 50mm round offset downpipe bend is an essential component for redirecting rainwater in drainage systems. Crafted from durable uPVC in a black finish, this 112.5° bend provides reliable water management for garages, sheds, summer houses and various garden buildings, ensuring efficient water flow away from foundations. The single socket design with pre-lubricated seals facilitate quick and secure installation, offering a long-lasting and low maintenance solution for effective rainwater drainage.
